historical_subjects.scope: Focused US2 acceptance tests and public API contract.
T034 and T035 immutable published projection, frozen media attribution, public API, ETag, and snapshot navigation.
T037, T038, T040, and T041 reader, content blocks, creative runtime, SEO, accessibility, lifecycle, and performance implementation.
Exact-source-head CI and Security workflow wiring.

evidence: Immutable v2 published snapshots freeze contributor, content, derived text, reading time, issue navigation, and public-safe media metadata.
Unknown or incomplete snapshot versions and legacy media snapshots fail closed.
Live media state is a deny-only gate; any REVOKED rights record takes precedence and responses are no-cache.
Public API covers stable ETag 200/304, canonical metadata, unpublished 404, frozen media, and snapshot navigation.
Eleven explicit SSR-safe v1 block renderers use a total deny-by-default registry.
The local trusted p5.js 2.x instance-mode registry bounds inputs, fixes seeds, coordinates one active loop, and calls noLoop/remove on lifecycle exits.
The public article route renders final-visible text and media before hydration with credits, fixed geometry, progress, centralized reduced-motion behavior, navigation, and accessible share fallback.
Canonical, Open Graph including a safe public image, JSON-LD, semantic publication dates, and readable no-JS output are implemented.
Axe, reduced-motion, route interruption, twenty-switch creative lifecycle, and media fallback geometry are represented in browser acceptance tests.
Lighthouse and bundle budgets are configured; p5 and local presets remain lazy and are removed from server resource hints.
T036 unknown block and unknown preset versions still render safe poster/summary fallback with telemetry and no content-driven module resolution.
T039 composable, tests, and checked task state are unchanged.
PublicationReliabilityIT has only the two imports required by the public-article package relocation; T056 behavior and checkbox remain unchanged.
No Web3, wallet, deployment, production activation, or migration files changed.

local_acceptance.details: make verify passed formatting, lint, TypeScript checks, API-client tests 2/2, content-schema tests 4/4, creative-runtime tests 8/8, web unit/component tests 75/75, OpenAPI validation, generation, and generated-client diff checks.
Production bundle verification found one lazy p5 chunk, one lazy host chunk, one local preset chunk, no server resource hints, and 354957 bytes incremental gzip against a 460800-byte budget.

Fixture-backed Nitro HTML contained canonical metadata, safe og:image and JSON-LD image, semantic dates, byline/body/TOC/rights/poster, no canvas, no p5/preset resource hint; ordinary and 404 paths degraded safely.
Playwright collected 30 tests across seven files, including independent US1, independent US2, combined regression, axe, no-JS, reduced-motion, CLS fallback, and creative lifecycle records.
All 185 Java sources parsed, internal imports resolved, exact PostgreSQL media eligibility probes denied any REVOKED record, and PUBLIC_WEB plus OFFLINE link probing returned one public media row.
git diff --check, CI/Security YAML parsing, positive and negative source-head verifier probes, frozen dependency install, and production dependency audit passed with no known vulnerabilities.
